summary: Unidentified homeowner receipts get their own account: 2420 Unidentified Receipts (Suspense), a current liability, in every operational community that has a 2400, and the account role 'unidentified_receipts' that Kat's reconciliation reads. Configuration only; no entry, balance or homeowner ledger changes.

preflight.name: 2420 is free in every community
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM chart_of_accounts WHERE account_number = '2420'

preflight.name: no unidentified_receipts role exists yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM community_account_roles WHERE role = 'unidentified_receipts'

preflight.name: operational communities with a postable 2400 (each gets a 2420)
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM chart_of_accounts p JOIN communities c ON c.id = p.community_id WHERE p.account_number = '2400' AND p.is_active AND NOT p.is_summary AND coalesce(c.management_status, 'active') IN ('active','onboarding','terminating') AND (c.management_end_date IS NULL OR c.management_end_date >= current_date)

expected_changes: community_account_roles: role 'unidentified_receipts' allowed; the guard accepts a credit-normal liability for that role only.
chart_of_accounts: 2420 Unidentified Receipts (Suspense) added in 5 operational communities (same fund and subtype as their 2400).
community_account_roles: 5 rows pointing unidentified_receipts at those accounts.
No journal entry, balance, reconciliation or homeowner ledger changes.

verify.name: five 2420 suspense liabilities
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM chart_of_accounts WHERE account_number = '2420' AND account_name = 'Unidentified Receipts (Suspense)' AND account_type = 'liability' AND normal_balance = 'credit'

verify.name: each in the same fund as its 2400
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM chart_of_accounts s JOIN chart_of_accounts p ON p.community_id = s.community_id AND p.account_number = '2400' AND p.fund_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM s.fund_id WHERE s.account_number = '2420'

verify.name: five roles, each on its community's 2420
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM community_account_roles r JOIN chart_of_accounts a ON a.id = r.account_id AND a.community_id = r.community_id WHERE r.role = 'unidentified_receipts' AND a.account_number = '2420'

verify.name: archived Eaglewood untouched
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM chart_of_accounts a JOIN communities c ON c.id = a.community_id WHERE a.account_number = '2420' AND c.management_status IN ('archived','terminated','prospect')
